title: Impressionism
description: Light, color, and fleeting moments from the movement that broke with the academy.

items.title: Water Lilies
items.description_narrative: This painting from Claude Monet's renowned 'Water Lilies' series captures the shimmering surface of a pond, reflecting light and sky. The composition emphasizes the delicate interplay of color and brushstroke, characteristic of the artist's focus on capturing fleeting moments in nature.
items.tags: water lilies, pond, nature, landscape, impressionism, french art, tranquil, reflections

items.title: Arrival of the Normandy Train, Gare Saint-Lazare
items.description_narrative: Claude Monet captures the bustling energy of a train pulling into Paris's Gare Saint-Lazare, its powerful locomotive shrouded in a plume of steam. Through vibrant brushstrokes, Monet masterfully explores the transient effects of light and atmosphere filtering through the vast glass and iron structure.
items.tags: train, station, paris, urban life, impressionism, light, atmosphere, steam

items.title: Stacks of Wheat (End of Summer)
items.description_narrative: Claude Monet's 'Stacks of Wheat (End of Summer)' is one of more than twenty-five canvases in his iconic 'Grainstacks' series. This artwork exemplifies Monet's dedication to capturing the subtle variations of light and color on a single subject across different times of day and seasons.
items.tags: landscape, impressionism, series, light, nature, wheat, summer

items.title: Cliff Walk at Pourville
items.description_narrative: Claude Monet captures a vibrant coastal scene, depicting two women strolling atop a cliff overlooking the sea. The painting exemplifies his Impressionist approach, characterized by distinct brushstrokes and an emphasis on the changing effects of light.
items.tags: coastal landscape, impressionism, seascape, women, outdoor scene, French painting, vibrant

items.title: Water Lily Pond
items.description_narrative: This oil on canvas depicts a tranquil water lily pond, a recurring subject in Claude Monet's later career. The painting focuses on the shimmering surface of the water, reflecting light and surrounding foliage.
items.tags: water lilies, pond, nature, impressionism, french art, landscape, serenity, reflection

items.title: The Beach at Sainte-Adresse
items.description_narrative: Claude Monet captures a vibrant seaside scene at Sainte-Adresse, depicting figures enjoying the sun-drenched beach amidst boats on the shimmering water. Painted in 1867, this oil on canvas work showcases Monet's early exploration of light, atmosphere, and modern life, foreshadowing his pivotal role in Impressionism.
items.tags: beach, seascape, figures, early impressionism, modern life, french art, light

items.title: Bordighera
items.description_narrative: Claude Monet's 'Bordighera' captures the vibrant coastal landscape of the Italian Riviera with a dazzling array of colors. Painted in 1884, this oil on canvas exemplifies Monet's dedication to rendering the changing effects of light and atmosphere.
items.tags: landscape, coastal, impressionism, oil painting, light, vibrant, 19th century

items.title: Stacks of Wheat (End of Day, Autumn)
items.description_narrative: This painting is part of Claude Monet's iconic 'Stacks of Wheat' series, capturing the changing effects of light and atmosphere on the same subject at different times of day. Here, the low sun of autumn casts long shadows and imbues the scene with a warm, golden glow.
items.tags: impressionism, landscape, wheat, stacks, autumn, light, series, french

items.title: Two Sisters (On the Terrace)
items.description_narrative: Pierre-Auguste Renoir's vibrant oil painting captures two young women seated on a sun-dappled terrace, characterized by his signature brushwork and luminous palette. The work exemplifies Impressionist principles through its focus on everyday life, natural light, and the fleeting moment.
items.tags: impressionism, portrait, figures, terrace, leisure, vibrant, oil painting, women

items.title: Woman at the Piano
items.description_narrative: This painting by Pierre-Auguste Renoir depicts a woman engrossed at a piano, rendered with the artist's characteristic soft brushwork and warm palette. Created between 1875 and 1876, it exemplifies Impressionist interest in capturing intimate domestic scenes and fleeting moments of modern life.
items.tags: woman, piano, music, domestic scene, impressionism, oil painting, intimacy

items.title: Lunch at the Restaurant Fournaise (The Rowers' Lunch)
items.description_narrative: Pierre-Auguste Renoir's "Lunch at the Restaurant Fournaise" captures a vibrant social scene at the Maison Fournaise, a popular spot on the Île de Chatou for boaters and artists. The painting exemplifies Renoir's early Impressionist style, focusing on light, color, and figures enjoying leisure time.
items.tags: lunch, restaurant, rowers, social scene, leisure, impressionism, french art

items.title: Chrysanthemums
items.description_narrative: Pierre-Auguste Renoir's 'Chrysanthemums' captures the vibrant beauty of a floral arrangement with characteristic Impressionistic brushwork. Painted with oil on canvas between 1881 and 1882, this work exemplifies his masterful use of color and light.
items.tags: chrysanthemums, flowers, still life, impressionism, nature, painting, vibrant

items.title: Seascape
items.description_narrative: Pierre-Auguste Renoir's *Seascape* captures a vibrant, sunlit scene, reflecting light off the rippling water and distant horizon. With expressive brushwork, the artist conveys the shifting colors and atmospheric effects of the coastal environment.
items.tags: seascape, ocean, impressionism, landscape, light, vibrant, 19th century

items.title: Near the Lake
items.description_narrative: Pierre-Auguste Renoir's "Near the Lake," an oil on canvas from 1879-80, captures a tranquil scene with the artist's characteristic brushwork and vibrant palette. This work exemplifies his Impressionist approach to rendering light and atmosphere in a natural setting.
items.tags: impressionism, landscape, figure, oil painting, nature, serene, French art

items.title: Alfred Sisley
items.description_narrative: This oil on canvas depicts fellow Impressionist painter Alfred Sisley, captured by Pierre-Auguste Renoir in 1876. Renoir portrays Sisley with a direct gaze, reflecting the intimate connection between the two artists.
items.tags: portrait, impressionism, french art, 19th century, painting, male, sisley, renoir

items.title: Ballet at the Paris Opéra
items.medium: Pastel over monotype on cream laid paper
items.description_narrative: Edgar Degas captures a moment from the ballet at the Paris Opéra, observing dancers either backstage or during a rehearsal rather than a formal performance. This work, created using pastel over monotype on cream laid paper, showcases his characteristic interest in movement and the fleeting nature of everyday life.
items.tags: ballet, dancers, opera, impressionism, realism, pastel, movement, backstage

items.title: The Millinery Shop
items.description_narrative: This painting by Edgar Degas depicts a woman absorbed in selecting or arranging hats in a Parisian millinery shop. The composition captures an intimate moment, reflecting Degas' interest in candid portrayals of contemporary life.
items.tags: millinery, shop, woman, hats, parisian life, impressionist, realism, everyday life

items.title: Jockey
items.medium: Graphite with stumping on tan wove paper
items.description_narrative: This drawing, executed in graphite with stumping on tan wove paper, captures a jockey in an athletic pose. It exemplifies Edgar Degas's meticulous study of human and animal forms in motion.
items.tags: jockey, horse racing, equestrian, drawing, graphite, figure study, realism, french art

items.title: Young Spartan Girls Challenging Boys
items.description_narrative: This early work by Edgar Degas depicts young Spartan girls engaging boys in a spirited challenge, a scene from ancient Greek athletic training. The composition, with its frieze-like arrangement and classical subject matter, reflects Degas's academic training and interest in historical painting.
items.tags: spartan, ancient greece, historical painting, youth, challenge, early degas, oil painting, french art

items.title: Yellow Dancers (In the Wings)
items.description_narrative: Edgar Degas captures a dynamic scene of ballet dancers backstage, bathed in a vibrant yellow light as they wait in the wings. This oil on canvas work from 1874–76 exemplifies Degas's keen interest in depicting candid moments and the unseen labor behind performance.
items.tags: ballet, dancers, backstage, impressionism, candid, oil painting, french

items.title: The Star
items.medium: Pastel on cream wove paper, edge mounted on board
items.description_narrative: Edgar Degas's 'The Star' captures a solitary ballerina in a moment of performance or repose, rendered with delicate light and shadow. Created between 1879 and 1881, this pastel on cream wove paper exemplifies Degas's keen observation of the ballet world.
items.tags: ballet, dancer, pastel, impressionism, performance, movement, french art

items.title: Henri Degas and His Niece Lucie Degas (The Artist's Uncle and Cousin)
items.description_narrative: This intimate double portrait by Edgar Degas depicts his uncle, Henri Degas, and his young niece, Lucie Degas. Created with oil on canvas between 1875 and 1876, the work offers a personal glimpse into the artist's family circle.
items.tags: portrait, family, oil painting, degas, 19th century, realism, impressionism, french art

items.title: Self-Portrait
items.medium: Etching in black on ivory laid paper
items.description_narrative: This striking self-portrait by Edgar Degas captures the artist in his youth, rendered with an intense gaze. Executed in 1857 as an etching, it showcases his early mastery of printmaking techniques.
items.tags: self-portrait, etching, printmaking, 19th century, french art, early work, degas

items.title: Woman Bathing Her Feet in a Brook
items.description_narrative: Camille Pissarro captures a tranquil moment as a woman dips her feet into a clear brook. The scene emphasizes the soft light and natural beauty of the outdoors, characteristic of Pissarro's intimate portrayals of rural life.
items.tags: landscape, impressionism, rural life, woman, bathing, nature, tranquil
